broker.name: Errante
broker.tagline: Its site names FSA (Seychelles) and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: Errante publishes this address: Office 15(B), 3rd Floor, Vairam Building, Providence, Mahe, Seychelles. The pages checked do not state a founding year. Account names on its site include Standard, Premium, VIP, and Tailor Made. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader, and TradingView. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles) and CySEC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.headquarters: Office 15(B), 3rd Floor, Vairam Building, Providence, Mahe, Seychelles
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Errante Securities (Seychelles) Limited, SD038. CySEC: Notely Trading Limited, 383/20.

leverage.note: FAQ on the same site says the leverage offered is up to 1:500. Forex specifications page lists 500:1 on many FX pairs and lower on some crosses. FAQ also says dynamic leverage can reduce maximum leverage as volume increases.
Conflicts with the Standard account table value of up to 1000:1.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, about, account types, FAQ and terms fetched. Licences and legal-documents pages returned almost no body text on direct fetch. Seychelles FSA SD038 and company number 8425493-1 are in the terms. CySEC CIF 383/20 for Notely Trading Limited (www.errante.eu, HE 394425) appeared in a search extract of the legal-documents page footer and was not in the rendered fetch; terms name Notely only for payment services and do not name CySEC. Founded 2019 and a Seychelles headquarters claim appear only inside a Forex Ratings review quoted on the about page, so founded is null. FAQ head office and terms registered office do not match. No current client promotion amount was stated on the fetched pages.
